report.explanation: Alert observations show only healthy checkout traffic: all four gateway requests returned 200 in 63-94 ms, matching logs and traces (all spans status 200, request_result ok). Metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout and p95 ~98 ms. No error, saturation, timeout, pool-exhaustion, or deployment evidence exists, so no public cause is substantiated. Handing off rather than asserting a fault.
missing_evidence: Error or non-2xx telemetry (e.g., 5xx/502 counts, error logs, failed spans) for the checkout path during the incident window
Latency baseline or SLO to determine whether observed 63-98 ms durations are anomalous
Dependency-level metrics (redis/postgres/payment latency, timeouts, pool utilization) to test redis-timeout or db-pool-exhaustion
Deployment or configuration change records near the incident window
Operator hypothesis or alert rule that triggered this incident, to scope the suspected fault
